task_completion.description: Open the chinook.odb database in LibreOffice Base.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The LibreOffice Base application window is visible showing 'chinook.odb' in the title bar or status bar.

task_completion.description: Select ArtistId and Name from the Artist table for the main form.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Form Wizard or Form Design view shows the 'Artist' table selected with 'ArtistId' and 'Name' added to the form fields.

task_completion.description: Enable a subform and select the Album table.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Form Wizard 'Add Subform' step is visible with 'Add subform' checked and the 'Album' table selected.

task_completion.description: Select the Title field for the subform and set it to datasheet format.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Title' field from the Album table is selected, and the 'Datasheet' arrangement option is chosen for the subform.

task_completion.description: Link the main form and subform using the ArtistId field.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Joined fields' step of the wizard shows 'ArtistId' selected for both 'First joined main field' and 'First joined subform field'.

task_completion.description: Save the form as 'ArtistDiscography' and display the final functional form.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A form window titled 'ArtistDiscography' is open, showing an Artist's name at the top and a datasheet of Album titles below it.

integrity.description: The agent used the existing Chinook database tables rather than creating new dummy tables.
integrity.visual_evidence: The table selection dropdowns in the wizard show the standard Chinook tables (Artist, Album, etc.).

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the actual LibreOffice software.
integrity.visual_evidence: Standard LibreOffice Base menus, icons, and wizard dialog boxes are visible throughout the process.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The database file is located at /home/ga/chinook.odb. The master table is 'Artist' (fields: ArtistId, Name) and the detail table is 'Album' (fields: AlbumId, Title, ArtistId). The relationship is defined by Album.ArtistId referencing Artist.ArtistId. The final form must be named 'ArtistDiscography' and the subform must specifically be in 'Datasheet' (grid) view.
